claims.claim: The configured GitHub Actions secret can authenticate requests to the Volcengine Ark video-generation API.
premises: repository Actions can read the secret

claims.claim: doubao-seedance-1-5-pro-251215 can generate a text-to-video task that completes and yields a downloadable MP4 through the tested Ark task lifecycle.
premises: service accepts the tested request schema

claims.claim: A readable local chat-uploaded image can be converted to base64 and written as binary content into the GitHub repository by create_blob -> create_tree -> create_commit -> update_ref.
premises: the chat file is locally readable
GitHub connector exposes create_blob with base64 encoding
claims.notes: Earlier create_file-centered failures falsified only those implementation paths, not binary upload capability.

claims.claim: A repository-hosted reference image URL can be fetched by the GitHub Actions runner and accepted by doubao-seedance-1-5-pro-251215 as image_url input for image-to-video generation.
A completed Seedance MP4 can be uploaded as a GitHub Actions Artifact, downloaded through the GitHub connector, and surfaced as a file in the current ChatGPT conversation.
premises: GitHub connector retains artifact read access
conversation runtime can materialize the downloaded file
invalidators: file-size or runtime policy outside tested domain

claims.claim: Failure of one GitHub upload interface does not establish that ChatGPT-to-GitHub binary transfer is impossible when other connector paths exist.
claims.notes: Prevents invalid generalization from one failed implementation route.

claims.claim: Character consistency, camera adherence, motion quality, prompt-handle reliability, and similar model-behavior qualities are probabilistic properties and are not established by one successful generation.
premises: generation process is non-deterministic or quality-sensitive

claims.claim: Each supplied model ID has a daily free allowance of 2,000,000 tokens.
premises: account/model entitlement is as reported by the user
claims.next_evidence_needed: authoritative account/control-plane or usage-interface confirmation if accessible

claims.claim: The exact model ID doubao-seedance-1-0-pro-fast-251015 accepts and completes the controlled minimal 5-second 16:9 text-to-video request in the current account.

Under the D-002 controlled request shape with no explicit resolution or audio field, Fast 251015 returned reported resolution 1080p and 246840 tokens, while 1.5 Pro 251215 returned reported resolution 720p and 108900 tokens.
premises: returned task metadata accurately describes each completed task
claims.notes: This is an observed default difference, not a universal cost formula or stable efficiency ranking.

claims.claim: For doubao-seedance-1-5-pro-251215 under the D-002 request shape, omitting generate_audio resulted in returned metadata generate_audio=true and the actual MP4 contained an AAC 44.1 kHz stereo audio stream.
claims.notes: Establishes default positive audio behavior in this tested domain; does not yet establish explicit enable/disable parameter semantics.

claims.claim: Fast 251015 completed the single D-002 sample sooner than 1.5 Pro (about 39.8 s vs 60.1 s), but one sample is insufficient for a stable speed ranking.
claims.next_evidence_needed: repeated contemporaneous controlled samples only if latency ranking becomes load-bearing
